name: Shilton Rodrigues
title: Full Stack Developer
summary: Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building responsive, production-grade web applications across the stack — Vue.js 3, React.js on the frontend and Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB on the backend, with working knowledge of Java and Kotlin. Hands-on experience designing and shipping AI-powered features, including LLM-integrated chatbots and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems with streaming responses, error handling, retries, and rate limiting. Comfortable across the full web development lifecycle: design, development, testing, and deployment.

Built and integrated AI-powered features — chatbots, call analysis, and content generation — using LLM APIs with RAG-based architecture
Integrated and tested REST APIs and microservices using Postman, and built secure backend logic with Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB

Collaborated with designers to deliver production-ready UI from Figma designs; built reusable components and shared UI libraries
Implemented authentication flows, API integration, and modular frontend architecture following MVC and clean-code best practices
Contributed to Agile sprint planning, code reviews, and Git-based version control
Worked hands-on with Docker, Jenkins, Git, and YAML for CI/CD automation and deployment workflows
Built UI screens using Bootstrap, Node.js, and MongoDB, applying responsive design best practices
